wins: Successfully completed automated reconnaissance templates covering initial port 80/443 and directory bruteforce, yielding consistent service banners and usernames (reward 70).
fails: Failed to establish foothold beyond low-privilege shell due to missing valid credentials on second host, showing 0% success rate for final objective.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase produced rich service data, but follow-on exploitation/privilege escalation remains unresolved; focus on targeted credential discovery and pivoting.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Pivot attempts stall when no valid credentials are obtained for secondary systems despite discovered SMB/WinRM services.

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service exposes interesting directories and PHP files
skill_cards.then_action: Run Gobuster with wordlist to enumerate hidden endpoints and fetch PHP contents for configuration leaks

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port is open and banner reveals vulnerable version
skill_cards.then_action: Run nmap with ssh2-enum-algos and ssh-auth-methods scripts to gather supported ciphers and auth options

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB service is detected but credential reuse fails
skill_cards.then_action: Run CrackMapExec with local user list and retry with NTLM relays to validate account reuse potential

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in SSH reconnaissance and consistent banner data useful for later exploitation.

next_experiments.title: Credential harvesting via misconfigured webapp
next_experiments.description: Deploy targeted config parsing script (e.g., python requests + regex) against discovered PHP admin pages to extract stored credentials for pivot.

next_experiments.title: SMB relay validation
next_experiments.description: Use CrackMapExec to capture NTLM challenge/response during failed login and attempt relay to identified WinRM service to validate lateral movement.
